ver: Version counter for this leaf node. Starts at 0. Incremented by 1 on every write.
updated_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last write to this node. Null if never written.
depends_on: Snapshot of dependency versions at the time this node was last written. Format: {dep_key: ver}. Empty dict {} for root nodes with no dependencies.
stale: True if any dependency's current ver differs from the ver recorded in depends_on.
stale_keys: List of dependency keys whose current ver differs from the recorded ver. Empty list [] when clean.
